memories.author: D04
memories.text:
BPV
- Status: intermittent positional vertigo lasting <1 minute, triggered by lying down; Dix-Hallpike positive on right.
- Plan: continue betahistine 16 mg BD; meclizine 25 mg SOS for acute episodes; advise vestibular rehabilitation exercises.

Migraine
- Status: 2-3 headache days/month, mild-moderate, responsive to sumatriptan.
- Plan: continue propranolol 40 mg OD; sumatriptan 50 mg SOS; topiramate 25 mg HS at bedtime; naproxen 500 mg SOS for breakthrough pain.

Weight: 58 kg; Waist: 78 cm (female cut‑off 80 cm).

Diet advice
- Breakfast: low‑glycaemic idli with sambar, avoid fried snacks.
- Lunch: wheat roti, dal, vegetable curry, limited rice.
- Dinner: light khichdi, early by 7 pm.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
BPV
- Status: vertigo episodes reduced to once weekly, mild.
- Plan: continue betahistine 16 mg BD; add vestibular rehab twice weekly.

Migraine
- Status: 1‑2 headache days/month, well controlled.
- Plan: maintain propranolol 40 mg OD; consider tapering topiramate if somnolence appears.

Weight: 57.5 kg; Waist: 77 cm.

Diet advice
- Breakfast: oats with milk, no added sugar.
- Lunch: mixed vegetable curry, two chapatis.
- Dinner: steamed rice limited to ½ cup, fish curry.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
BPV
- Status: vertigo absent for past 3 weeks.
- Plan: continue betahistine 16 mg BD; consider trial off meclizine.

Migraine
- Status: headache‑free for 4 weeks.
- Plan: continue propranolol 40 mg OD; trial off topiramate, monitor for rebound.

Weight: 57 kg; Waist: 76 cm.

Diet advice
- Breakfast: poha with peanuts, no sugar.
- Lunch: dal, sabzi, two chapatis.
- Dinner: vegetable soup, one roti.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Audiometry: bilateral mild high‑frequency hearing loss (25 dB at 4‑8 kHz), otherwise normal.
Dix‑Hallpike: right‑side positive, transient torsional nystagmus.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Refer to ENT, Dr S. Rao, for evaluation of persistent positional vertigo and hearing loss. Request audiogram review and vestibular testing.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: ENT report: benign positional vertigo confirmed, no central pathology. Recommend Epley maneuver; hearing loss age‑related, no intervention needed. Follow‑up in 6 months if symptoms recur.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
BPV
- Status: no vertigo episodes since last visit; Epley maneuver performed successfully.
- Plan: discontinue betahistine; keep meclizine SOS only.

Migraine
- Status: occasional mild headache (1‑2 days/month), well controlled on propranolol.
- Plan: continue propranolol 40 mg OD; restart topiramate 25 mg HS if frequency rises.

Weight: 56.5 kg; Waist: 75 cm.

Diet advice
- Breakfast: upma with vegetables, limited oil.
- Lunch: brown rice two‑thirds cup, sambar, salad.
- Dinner: grilled chicken, steamed vegetables, one roti.

Migraine

- Plan: continue propranolol 40 mg OD; taper off if remains headache‑free for another 3 months.
